title: Own Your Limits: 'Only a Little' Answers

scenes.line1: Ever get asked about a skill
scenes.say: Ever get asked about a skill you’ve only touched a little? Here’s how to nail that answer.

scenes.label: Honesty
scenes.sub: Bluffing gets caught fast. Clear honesty scores.
scenes.say: Bluffing gets caught on follow-ups. Clear honesty actually scores points.

rows.b: Be clear what you haven't done

scenes.say: First, say what you’ve done. Next, admit what you haven’t. Then, explain how you’d approach the task.

scenes.title: What it sounds like
lines: $ I haven't owned it end to end.
scenes.say: Here’s what it sounds like: I’ve worked alongside Graph Q L. I haven’t owned it end to end, but here’s how I’d approach it.

scenes.question: What if you just say 'yes' to everything?
scenes.right: You get caught on follow-ups and lose trust.
scenes.say: What if you just say yes to everything? You’ll get caught on follow-ups and lose trust fast.
